title: Ambition tiers
purpose: Declare how far the venture means to go, which sets the depth of research and the phases it aims for. A framework for thinking whose answer is a canonical goal of kind scale (Torian, 2026-10-30).

vocabulary.hobby: not engaged in for profit (the IRS sense)
vocabulary.lifestyle: a business that supports the owner's life, not growth for its own sake
vocabulary.managed-growth: growth at a pace the owners choose
vocabulary.aggressive-growth: growth as fast as capital allows, usually with investors expecting an exit

frames.question: Why does the venture exist, and how far through the phases does it mean to go?
